scoring_policy.runtime_or_parser_failure: exclude from endpoint denominator and report the failure count and rate; never map a failure to a negative prediction
scoring_policy.defer: retain as an intentional selective prediction; exclude from covered-risk numerator and denominator while reporting defer rate and coverage
scoring_policy.tool_unavailable: retain the frozen first-pass action and report escalation_failure; do not synthesize evidence or substitute another arm
scoring_policy.semantic_gate: inspect each check's eligible flag and named counter; a false top-level passed value alone is not a system-error diagnosis
scoring_policy.cohort_isolation: score paired image, no-IR, no-reference, novel-template, held-out-severity, deck S2/S5, and SlideAudit cohorts independently
scoring_policy.deck: report S2 and S5 recall and specificity separately; do not replace them with a pooled balanced aggregate
scoring_policy.slideaudit: treat confident_absent as the named negative and paired_clean as false; report the image-only and no-native-IR/reference boundary

rerun_policy.validation: resume by record_id only after a logged infrastructure or process interruption; never rerun because an endpoint is unfavorable
rerun_policy.final_test: one attempt only; an additional attempt requires a logged system or parsing failure, an explicit new unlock decision, and preserved evidence from the failed attempt
